summary: Lando Norris launches McLaren's championship charge from pole position at the unforgiving new Madrid circuit, edging Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen in a battle that could reshape the title fight. George Russell's warnings about the track's punishing nature add another layer of complexity—one mistake in the high-risk layout could turn strategy into salvage operation for any frontrunner. A clean victory for Norris would hand McLaren crucial momentum, while Verstappen's third-place grid slot makes this a defining moment to either close the gap or watch it widen irreversibly.
